# `quadrant`

A quick 2×2 matrix for sorting ideas. Drag items into quadrants, label the axes, and share the result as a link.


<div align="center">
  
[<kbd><br>haaans.com/quadrant<br><br></kbd>](https://haaans.com/quadrant/?%3D%3D)

</div>


<p align="center">
<img src="demos/hero.png" alt="app" width="500">
</p>

## Features

<table>
<tr valign="top">
<td width="50%">
<h3>Drag items into place</h3>
<p>Grab any item and drop it where it belongs. The matrix is free-form, so where an item sits is the whole point.</p>
</td>
<td width="50%">
<img src="demos/drag.gif" alt="Drag items into place">
</td>
</tr>
<tr valign="top">
<td width="50%">
<img src="demos/add.gif" alt="Press A, then name it">
</td>
<td width="50%">
<h3>Press A, then name it</h3>
<p>Press A to drop a new item onto the matrix, then double-click it to rename it.</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr valign="top">
<td width="50%">
<h3>Restyle from the icon</h3>
<p>Click an item's icon to pick a size, a color, or one of over a hundred Material icons.</p>
</td>
<td width="50%">
<img src="demos/style.gif" alt="Restyle from the icon">
</td>
</tr>
<tr valign="top">
<td width="50%">
<img src="demos/duplicate.gif" alt="Duplicate or delete by dragging">
</td>
<td width="50%">
<h3>Duplicate or delete by dragging</h3>
<p>Hold Alt and drag to copy an item. Drag one off the matrix to delete it.</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr valign="top">
<td width="50%">
<h3>Save versions, share a link</h3>
<p>Press S or click save to keep a version in your history. Share copies a link with the whole matrix in the URL, with no account or database.</p>
</td>
<td width="50%">
<img src="demos/save.gif" alt="Save versions, share a link">
</td>
</tr>
</table>
